problems.problem: NH₃ and H₂O are not tetrahedral molecular shapes; they are trigonal pyramidal and bent respectively. Only CH₄ (AX₄) has a tetrahedral molecular geometry.
problems.verifierReason: Original lists NH3 and H2O as tetrahedral molecular shapes; they are trigonal pyramidal and bent. Correction correctly lists only CH4.

problems.quote: a concept later formalised by the magnitude‑frequency relationship introduced by William Morris Davis in his geographical cycle of erosion
problems.problem: The magnitude‑frequency relationship was not introduced by William Morris Davis; it was formalised by Wolman and Miller (1960).
problems.correction: a concept later formalised by the magnitude‑frequency relationship introduced by Wolman and Miller (1960)
problems.verifierReason: Davis did not introduce magnitude-frequency relationship; Wolman & Miller (1960) did.

problems.quote: Paleoceanographic evidence from sediment cores indicates that such slowdowns occurred during past glacial terminations, leading to abrupt climate shifts known as Dansgaard‑Oeschger events.
problems.problem: Dansgaard-Oeschger events are rapid climate oscillations during glacial periods, not specifically during glacial terminations (which are transitions to interglacials).
problems.correction: Paleoceanographic evidence from sediment cores indicates that such slowdowns occurred during past glacial periods, leading to abrupt climate shifts known as Dansgaard‑Oeschger events.
problems.verifierReason: Original incorrectly places D-O events at glacial terminations; correction to glacial periods is accurate.

problems.quote: Since the adoption of the Constitution in 1950, successive governments have sought to translate the pledge of “socialist” and “secular” ideals into concrete programmes
problems.problem: The terms "socialist" and "secular" were not in the original Constitution adopted in 1950; they were added to the Preamble by the 42nd Amendment in 1976.
problems.correction: Since the 42nd Amendment in 1976 added “socialist” and “secular” to the Preamble, successive governments have sought to translate these ideals into concrete programmes
problems.verifierReason: Original wrongly places socialist/secular in 1950 Constitution; correction correctly cites 42nd Amendment 1976.

problems.quote: The landmark Supreme Court judgment in Union of India v. N. S. Raghavan (1995) interpreted these provisions to include a citizen’s right to know the functioning of public authorities.
problems.problem: The landmark judgment recognizing the right to information under Article 19(1)(a) is State of U.P. v. Raj Narain (1975) or S.P. Gupta v. Union of India (1981); Union of India v. N. S. Raghavan (1995) is not the recognized landmark case for this principle.
problems.correction: The landmark Supreme Court judgment in State of U.P. v. Raj Narain (1975) interpreted these provisions to include a citizen’s right to know the functioning of public authorities.
problems.verifierReason: Original cites incorrect case; Raj Narain (1975) is the landmark judgment recognizing right to information under Art 19(1)(a).

problems.quote: The department must acknowledge the request within 5 days and provide the information within 30 days, or issue a valid exemption.
problems.problem: The RTI Act, 2005 does not mandate acknowledgment of an RTI request within 5 days; it only requires the Public Information Officer to provide information within 30 days (or 48 hours for life/liberty) or reject with valid exemption.
problems.correction: The department must provide the information within 30 days (or 48 hours in cases concerning life and liberty), or issue a valid exemption.
problems.verifierReason: RTI Act mandates 30-day/48-hour response, not 5-day acknowledgment; correction accurately reflects statutory timelines.

problems.quote: Banking Regulation Act amended in 2020 to bring all co-operative banks under RBI's direct supervision
problems.problem: The 2020 amendment brought urban and multi-state cooperative banks under RBI's direct supervision; rural cooperative banks (StCBs, DCCBs, PACS) remain under dual regulation (RBI + State).
problems.correction: Banking Regulation Act amended in 2020 to bring urban and multi-state co-operative banks under RBI's direct supervision
problems.verifierReason: Original overstates scope; correction correctly limits to urban/multi-state co-op banks.

problems.quote: AU SFB received in-principle approval for universal bank status in 2025
problems.problem: AU Small Finance Bank received in-principle approval from RBI to convert into a universal bank in April 2024, not 2025.
problems.correction: AU SFB received in-principle approval for universal bank status in 2024
problems.verifierReason: AU SFB got in-principle approval in April 2024, not 2025; correction fixes year.

problems.quote: India adopted BASEL III from 1 April 2019 (fully phased in by 2022)
problems.problem: India began phased implementation of Basel III on 1 April 2013; capital requirements were fully phased in by March 2019 and the capital conservation buffer by March 2020.
problems.correction: India implemented Basel III from April 2013 (fully phased in by 2020)
problems.verifierReason: India began Basel III in 2013, fully phased by 2020; original dates wrong, correction accurate.
